animation.origin: right to left (inactive collapses right, expands left on hover)

linkActive.indicator: underline via pseudo-element at full width

characterDescription: A navigation of inscriptional presence — uppercase micro-typography at 0.08em letter spacing, now with 34px between items creating a more measured, airy cadence across the top bar. Hairline underline animations wipe in right-to-left on hover. The expanded item spacing is not decorative — it gives each navigation node room to be read individually, like words on a page rather than items in a list.

_twist.type: E. Item spacing change — more spread
_twist.description: itemSpacing increased from 24px to 34px (+10px, intensity 3). The wider item cadence opens the nav bar horizontally, giving each link more breathing room and reinforcing the editorial quality of the typographic system.
